steps.explanation: atan2 gives the correct angle in any quadrant, unlike plain arctan

spec.body_markdown:
## Direction

Direction describes which way a vector points, usually as an angle θ measured counter-clockwise from the positive x-axis, or as a compass bearing.

Given components (v_x, v_y), θ = atan2(v_y, v_x) recovers the direction correctly in every quadrant (plain arctan alone is ambiguous between quadrants I/III and II/IV). Direction is independent of magnitude - scaling a vector's length never changes which way it points.
